title: Implement AI condensation via generateObject (Stage 1b Part B)
description: Implement src/lib/ai/condense.ts which optionally compresses large scraped content into a ~500-token structured business profile using generateObject. Only runs when combined text exceeds ~4,000 tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns the input extractedData unchanged if token estimate is under 4000
The AI prompt instructs the model to extract key business info from the scraped content

steps.description: Implement the token check and early return
steps.details: If `extractedData.totalTokenEstimate < 4000`, convert the extractedData directly to a CondensedProfile format (no API call) and return. This avoids unnecessary API costs for small sites.

technicalNotes: The condensation step costs ~$0.005 per call (cheap Sonnet call on ~4000 tokens).
The prompt should instruct the AI to: extract business name, services offered, contact info, testimonials, USPs, and years in business.
Pass the industry from the prospect record to help the AI understand context.
